thread:
maya: heads-up: quota spike showing on embeddings route during overnight ingest tests. console shows single requests with massive token counts. anyone touch batching?
chris: saw alerts at ~02:25 UTC, org quota got smoked. graphs show one physical request with tokens equivalent to hundreds of smaller calls.
linh: we shipped the 1.4.0 client canary yesterday that enables a new 'bulk_opt' path. it coalesces calls for throughput.
jamal: can you paste the callsite that triggers it? i'm curious about default args.
chris: sample (python):
```python
# old (1.3.x)
client.embeddings.create(inputs, model='embed-16k', batch_size=128)
# new (1.4.0)
client.embeddings.create(inputs, model='embed-16k')  # bulk_opt auto-enabled
```
maya: the problem is console attribution. the tile groups by api_name, so when SDK joins several logical requests we lose per-tenant breakdown. support is getting pings.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: SDK 1.4.0 canary rollout reached ~15% of orgs at 2024-10-11T02:20:00Z.
linh: we considered shipping per-item metadata (tiny index array) but avoided it to keep payloads tight. adding a compact offsets array would let the server attribute tokens back to original logical items cheaply.
jamal: short-term options: 1) revert default to bulk_opt=false, 2) platform-level split on token cap, 3) add temporary console heuristics to estimate logical counts.
maya: ops likes defensive split server-side to prevent quota meltdown. devex wants the client default revert so user-visible behavior doesn't surprise customers.
linh: i'll cut a patch to flip default and publish 1.4.1. small change.
linh: proposed snippet:
```diff
- BULK_OPT_DEFAULT = True
+ BULK_OPT_DEFAULT = False  # safer opt-in
```
chris: medium-term: if we keep bulk_opt we must include route_shards or item_index so telemetry can rehydrate original mapping and console can show per-customer metrics. also we should record client_version in physical requests.
jamal: add a soft alert for tokens-per-physical-request so ops sees abnormal single-request token usage before quotas drop.
maya: can we also add sampled tracing that logs full per-item metadata for 2% of bulked calls? that would help debug without huge telemetry cost.
linh: plan: 1) publish SDK 1.4.1 with default revert (ETA 3h), 2) server-side token-split guard (ETA EOD), 3) sampling + console heuristic (ship within 72h).
chris: i'll draft the support blurb and update release notes + console banner. include opt-out instructions and link to updated SDK docs.
ops-bot: incident-bot: opened INC-2024-embed-bulk for eng-platform. assigned.
maya: thanks team. keep posting updates here when 1.4.1 is published and when the guard lands.
linh: 1.4.1 tag published, canary starting now, i'll add the changelog and canary coordinates in a follow-up. :rocket:
